newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MTBE firms again on high refinery rates.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MTBE firms again on high refinery rates.

text.p: U.S. spot MTBE prices continued their nearly month-long climb, harassed higher on Thursday by high production rates of reformulated gasoline and tight supply of this gasoline additive, players said.
An earlier than expected turnaround at the about 15,000 barrel-per-day Belvieu Environmental Fuels plant in Texas this week added fuel to the fire.
"The market is tight all round. There are turnarounds in Europe, here, Venezuela, and demand is good," said a U.S. trader.
In addition, high refinery run rates -- a trend that is expected to continue -- has increased RFG output and brought many refiners to the market to buy MTBE.
"I attribute the strength in MTBE to high RFG production," said an MTBE trader.
The latest American Petroleum Institute report showed refinery rates at 95.6 pct of capacity for the week ended July 4, 1997.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, MTBE for July 20-30 delivery was bought by a refiner on Wednesday for 91.00 cents a gallon, up about 1.50 cents from late Monday.
In the East Coast, New York Harbor material was snapped up by a refiner for July 15-20 delivery for 93.50 cents.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk 1212 859-1631--
